source.usageBoundary: High-level spatial questions only; no upstream code, CSS, prose, names, tests, assets, screenshots, labels, or distinctive sequences copied or translated.

entries.sourceUse: Question only: which region owns height and scrolling?
entries.targetSurface: public home map, mobile controls, detail/list sheets
entries.rationale: Prevent overlapping map, sheet, and fixed-control regions from competing for viewport and scroll ownership.
entries.adaptation: Tzudong-local map-canvas-none and explicit desktop/mobile task owners, safe-area offsets, focus transfer/restore, and one intentional horizontal category reel.
entries.ownershipBoundary: Tzudong public map runtime; parent selection, privacy location gate, map lifecycle, and dynamic imports remain authoritative.

entries.sourceUse: Question only: what is the workspace task and which pane owns overflow?
entries.targetSurface: shared application shell and admin module workspace
entries.rationale: Keep skip navigation, sidebar, active canvas, and module actions reachable without nested document overflow.
entries.adaptation: Focusable local skip targets, bounded grid rows, shrink-safe flex children, one admin-canvas task owner, and existing module owner handoff.
entries.ownershipBoundary: Tzudong admin routing/auth/query state and lazy module registry remain unchanged.

entries.sourceUse: Question only: how should list/detail and two-pane work reflow under stress?
entries.targetSurface: admin overview, trend proposal list/detail, overlay panel
entries.rationale: Long Korean evidence, hashes, and dense proposal lists must not create hidden nested scroll owners or horizontal document overflow.
entries.adaptation: Local minmax and min-width guards, bounded desktop/mobile task owners, anywhere wrapping, and preserved guarded action order.
entries.ownershipBoundary: Tzudong map ownership, route/query contracts, and Preview-Confirm-Apply-Readback-Audit workflow remain authoritative.

entries.sourceUse: Question only: how do chat, canvas, and readback divide responsibility across widths?
entries.rationale: Preserve readable long RAG traces and a logical chat-before-canvas focus path while retaining desktop productivity.
entries.adaptation: Tzudong-local split/stack primitives, narrow parent-owned scrolling, shrink/wrap guards, keyboard-visible horizontal tool rails, and reduced-motion complete text.
entries.ownershipBoundary: Tzudong async jobs, RAG steer/trace, provider provenance, auth, APIs, and lazy loading remain unchanged.
